home.faqDownloadA: Public download is not available yet. A verified store link will appear on the project status page when the release is ready. We will announce a date only once it is confirmed.
home.faqOfflineQ: Does the app work without internet?
home.faqOfflineA: Yes. V1 is being prepared as an offline app with a local profile. It does not offer Google sign-in, sync, or AI services. Your chosen file provider, browser, or email app may use the internet independently of KOVA.
home.faqBankQ: Do I need to connect my bank account?
home.faqBankA: No. KOVA does not ask for your bank passwords. Accounts in the app help organise the financial information you record.
home.faqEstimateQ: Are forecasts and net pay amounts guaranteed?
home.faqEstimateA: No. They are estimates based on recorded data and configuration. They may differ from actual payments and do not replace employer documents or individual advice.
home.faqWebsiteQ: Can this website access my finances?
home.faqWebsiteA: No. The website introduces the project and does not connect to the financial database on your phone. Optional website analytics depends on your consent.

home.faqFreeA: Yes. Offline Free V1 has no ads, purchases, subscriptions, or paywalls. Local features do not require registration or a paid backend service.

home.faqBackupQ: How do I protect my data or change phones?
home.faqBackupA: Create a password-protected manual export and store it safely outside your phone. Import requires confirmation and replaces the supported data of the selected profile. It is a partial copy, not a full app image: embedded note images are included, but external attachments and receipt photos need separate copies. The publisher cannot restore data from the cloud or recover your backup password.
home.faqOcrA: OCR uses a model bundled with the app. Take a photo or choose one from your gallery through the Android picker. Recognition can be wrong — check the amount, currency, and date before saving. Denying camera access does not block file selection.
home.faqDeviceQ: Which devices and audience is KOVA for?
home.faqDeviceA: Android phones running Android 7.0 or later, with PL/EN/RU interfaces. Compatibility testing is ongoing. The intended audience is 13+, but this is not an approved Google Play rating or confirmation of availability in every country. No watch or iOS release is offered.

status.label: Project status
status.title: Offline V1. Before launch.
status.intro: We’re preparing free KOVA for Android phones: no registration, ads, subscriptions, or cloud sync. The release is not publicly available yet.
cards: First-release scope
Accounts, transactions and categories, budgets, debts, goals, net worth, recurring payments, work profiles and hours, reports, calendar, notes, on-device OCR, and manual encrypted export/import.
What has been checked

APK and AAB artifacts have been built. Tests ran on Android 7.0, 7.1, and an actual 16 KiB runtime. Encrypted export transfer between isolated installations and repeated import without duplicates were also checked. These are bounded scenarios, not a guarantee for every phone.
What remains
The full normal-interface and accessibility matrix, the current candidate on a physical phone, document approval, signing, and Google Play requirements. Current release artifacts are unsigned.
Outside Offline V1
Google/Firebase accounts, cloud services, online family sharing, banking APIs, live quotes, AI, Wear OS, Premium, and purchases are not active in this release. No availability date is confirmed.
status.note: We will publish a launch date or download button only after the release and official store address have been approved.

roadmap.label: Roadmap
roadmap.title: A reliable offline release first.
roadmap.intro: We’re finishing qualification of existing features. This plan does not promise dates or new services.
cards: 01 · Final tests
Complete the remaining normal-interface, language, and accessibility scenarios, and check the current version on a phone. Completed checks are not a blanket claim of readiness.
02 · Information and policies
Publisher and contact details are confirmed. Offline documents remain drafts: terms, support practices, markets, audience, and public addresses still require approval.
03 · Store candidate
Approve signing and Google Play configuration, and complete required tests and declarations. The official link follows release approval.
Later · Separate qualification
Future modules remain in the project but are not enabled. Cloud services, AI, Wear OS, and monetization need separate decisions, testing, and user disclosures.

security.label: Privacy and security
security.title: Local data. Clear limitations.
security.intro: Offline V1 stores finances on your phone. It does not create an online account or sync records with a server.
cards: Database on your device
Financial data uses Room and SQLCipher with profile isolation. Encryption cannot prevent every loss of a phone, password, key, or device access. We do not claim independent security certification.
No automatic uploads

The checked release manifest has no INTERNET permission. Firebase, app analytics, Crashlytics, ads, Billing, and AI services are disabled. This does not mean Android or other apps produce no network traffic.
Export is your choice

Manual export can be password-encrypted. It covers supported records, not a complete installation image: embedded note images travel with it; external file references do not copy the file itself. Store the password and file securely. There is no automatic KOVA cloud backup.
Photos and OCR
Recognition uses a model bundled with the app. You can take a photo or choose one from the gallery. Check the amount, currency, and date before saving — OCR can make mistakes.
The website is separate

This site cannot read the phone database. Only after consent, Google Analytics measures visits and interactions on the public site. Consent can be withdrawn in the footer; see Cookies for details. Future hosting may process connection data — its configuration and policies need approval.
Report safely

Describe issues at contact@kovacompass.app. Do not send passwords, keys, full database copies, or real financial records. Include the app version, Android version, and reproduction steps with example data.

updates.label: Updates
updates.title: KOVA moves to Offline Free V1.
updates.intro: An update on the upcoming release, not a launch announcement.
cards: No mandatory account
Public V1 is designed to work without registration or internet. Online services are preserved for the future but disabled in this release.
Notes and data portability

The editor’s Android 7 compatibility was fixed. Checks covered persistence after restart, embedded images, export, and normal import between isolated Android 7.1 and 7.0 installations. The current editor was also checked on 16 KiB.
Results, not a readiness claim

Full regression on 21 October: 6745 PASS out of 6746 cases, 1 FAIL for draft legal documents, 0 execution errors, and 0 skipped. Later targeted tests are not added to this count. Some UI qualification and the current phone check remain.
Documents and contact
The site uses current Offline V1 document drafts in PL/EN/RU and confirmed publisher details. This is not final legal approval or a store publication.

delete-account.label: Your data
delete-account.title: Export and delete local data.
delete-account.intro: Offline V1 does not create a cloud account. A local profile or financial account in KOVA is not an online account or a bank connection.
cards: Save what you need first
In data settings, use manual encrypted export of supported records and select a destination. Keep the password. This is a partial export, not a copy of every setting, key, and installation file.
Delete local data

To remove data for the whole installation, open Android settings → Apps → KOVA → Storage → Clear data, or uninstall KOVA. Labels vary by system. Without a valid backup this is irreversible; it may affect every local profile in that installation.
Files outside the app

Delete exported copies, original photos, and files held by other providers separately. An image embedded in a note may be included in export; an external URI is only a reference. The publisher cannot remotely access your local database.
Messages to the publisher
For data shared by email, contact contact@kovacompass.app. Do not attach financial backups. This page neither deletes data nor sends an automatic request.

cookies:
Cookies

Analytics is your choice.

Essential cookies remember language and settings. Analytics starts only after consent.

Updated: 22 October 2026No advertising

Essential

kova_site_language remembers language for up to 12 months; kova_cookie_consent_v2 remembers your choice for 180 days. Previous consent to local counters does not authorize Google Analytics.

Google Analytics 4

After consent on the public kovacompass.app domain (including www), we load Google tag G-2LE3GWYDZM. Google may store _ga and _ga_2LE3GWYDZM cookies for browser and session recognition. We configure 180-day expiry without automatic renewal on every visit; browsers may shorten this period.

What we measure

Page views, opening and playing the presentation, chapter selection, enlarged screenshots, opened FAQs and contact clicks. Our events contain only the event name, public page without URL parameters or fragments, and language. We do not send message contents, finances, account IDs or Workspace contents. Local previews do not run Google Analytics.

Recipient and basis

Publisher: Vadyslav Konohrai, Poland; contact: contact@kovacompass.app. Optional measurement relies on your consent. Google Analytics also processes technical browser, device, session and approximate location information. IP addresses are involved in communication; Google states GA4 does not store IP addresses. This does not make the data fully anonymous. Processing may take place outside the EEA. See Google’s privacy policy and GA4 data information.

Site language

The language choice also remains in localStorage until browser storage is cleared. KOVA account data is not stored here.

Change your choice

Open “Cookie settings” in the footer and reject analytics, or turn it off and save. Refusing does not limit the site. Withdrawal removes accessible GA cookies and reloads the page to stop the tag. It cannot recall data already sent. Contact us about data rights; you may also complain to the relevant data protection authority. Privacy documents remain readable without choosing consent.

Pre-publication status

Draft information updated 22 October 2026. Integration is website-only; the Offline V1 app remains analytics-free. Google Signals and advertising consent are disabled in code. Before publication the publisher must confirm processing terms, transfers, GA4 service retention (separate from cookie lifetime), disabled automatic enhanced measurement, and hosting configuration. Local tests do not verify these settings.
